scripts.check:affected: turbo run format:check lint check-types build --affected
scripts.check:no-dirty: node -e "const {existsSync} = require('node:fs'); const {execSync} = require('node:child_process'); if (!existsSync('.git')) process.exit(0); try { execSync('git diff --quiet --', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch (error) { console.error('husky pre-commit: formatting/typecheck updated files. stage changes and re-run commit.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.precommit: pnpm quality && pnpm check-types && pnpm check:no-dirty
